# Dependencies

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### External services

| Service | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| CalDAV servers (`OkHttpCalDavClient.kt`, `CalDavQuirks.kt`) | Two-way calendar and RFC 6638 scheduling sync with iCloud (`caldav.icloud.com`), Nextcloud, Radicale, Baïkal, Stalwart, SOGo, Cyrus, Xandikos, Fastmail, Zoho, Mailbox.org, and Purelymail. |
| CardDAV servers (`OkHttpCardDavClient.kt`) | Two-way contact and photo sync with RFC 6352 address books via `ContactPullStrategy.kt` and `ContactPushStrategy.kt`. |
| ICS / Webcal HTTP servers (`IcsRefreshWorker.kt`) | Periodic read-only fetching of subscribed `.ics` calendar feeds (`https://`, `webcal://`, `webcals://`). |
| Tasks.org Android app (`TasksOrgContract.kt`, `org.tasks`) | Local IPC via ContentProvider (`content://org.tasks.api/v0`) to read and write tasks, lists, tags, places, and reminders (`docs/fork/FORK_FEATURES.md`). |
| TomTom Routing API (`TomTomRoutingProvider.kt`) | Online route calculation with live traffic delays (`https://api.tomtom.com/routing/1/calculateRoute`) using a user-supplied API key. |
| Stadia Maps Routing API (`StadiaMapsProvider.kt`) | Online Valhalla route calculation (`https://api.stadiamaps.com/route/v1`) using a user-supplied API key. |
| OpenStreetMap Valhalla Demo (`ValhallaDemoProvider.kt`) | Free, keyless online Valhalla route calculation (`https://valhalla1.openstreetmap.de/route`). |
| Android `CalendarProvider` & `ContactsContract` (`AndroidCalendarProviderRepository.kt`, `AndroidContactsProviderRepository.kt`, `ContactSyncWorker.kt`) | OS-level ContentProviders for device calendars, synced CardDAV contacts, and contact birthday/anniversary events. |
| Android `LocationManager` & `Geocoder` (`TravelLocationProvider.kt`) | AOSP location fixes and address-to-coordinate resolution for departure alerts without Google Play Services. |

### Internal libraries

| Package / Module | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `:app` (`app/build.gradle.kts`) | Main Android application (`org.onekash.kashcal.tasks`) containing Compose UI, Glance widgets, ViewModels, domain coordinators, Room database, CalDAV/CardDAV sync engines, Tasks.org integration, travel-time routing, and SAF backups. |
| `:icaldav-core` (`icaldav-core/build.gradle.kts`) | Pure-JVM library wrapping `org.mnode.ical4j:ical4j:4.3.0` for RFC 5545 iCalendar parsing (`ICalParser`), generation (`ICalGenerator`), RFC 5546 iTIP methods (`ITipBuilder`), and recurrence expansion (`RRuleExpander`). |
| `:vcard-core` (`vcard-core/build.gradle.kts`) | Pure-JVM library wrapping `com.googlecode.ez-vcard:ez-vcard:0.12.2` (with `jsoup` and `jackson` excluded) for RFC 2426 / RFC 6350 vCard parsing (`VCardParser`) and serialization (`VCardWriter`). |

### Shared infrastructure

- **WorkManager (`androidx.work:work-runtime-ktx:2.11.2`)**: Executes background and expedited jobs via Hilt-injected workers (`CalDavSyncWorker`, `ContactSyncWorker`, `ContactEventSyncWorker`, `IcsRefreshWorker`, `ReminderRefreshWorker`, `TravelAlarmWorker`, `AutoBackupWorker`, `CalendarBackupWorker`, `WidgetRetryWorker`) initialized in `KashCalApplication.kt`.
- **Android `AlarmManager` & BroadcastReceivers (`ReminderScheduler.kt`, `DeviceCalendarReminderScheduler.kt`)**: Schedules exact wakeups handled by `ReminderAlarmReceiver`, `ReminderActionReceiver`, `DeviceCalendarAlarmReceiver`, `BootCompletedReceiver`, `TimezoneChangeReceiver`, and `MidnightWidgetUpdateReceiver`.
- **Room / SQLite Queues & FTS4 (`KashCalDatabase.kt`)**: Persistent `pending_operations` and `pending_cancels` queues for offline-first sync mutations, `scheduled_reminders` for alarm state, `sync_logs` and `recent_changes` for sync audit trails, and `events_fts` (FTS4) for full-text search.
- **DataStore & EncryptedSharedPreferences (`KashCalDataStore.kt`, `UnifiedCredentialManager.kt`)**: Reactive preference streams (`datastore-preferences:1.2.1`) and hardware-backed encrypted credential storage (`security-crypto:1.1.0`).
- **In-memory Routing Resilience (`RouteCache.kt`, `CircuitBreaker.kt`)**: Singleton LRU route cache (64 entries, 15-minute TTL) and per-provider circuit breaker protecting `TravelAlarmWorker` from slow or rate-limited routing APIs.
